summary: Brother Anton sends you from Desolace to Southshore with a sealed letter for Raleigh the Devout. Your deeds against the undead are only the beginning; Lordaeron holds the plague's true danger.

sections.title: Strongholds of the Crusade
sections.body: Brother Anton takes pride in the Scarlet Crusade's strongholds in Lordaeron. The Crusade claims cleansing bastions from Hearthglen to Tirisfal Glades. Your work against the undead in Desolace has proven you, Anton says. Yet the plague's true danger lies in Lordaeron.

sections.title: A Letter for Southshore
sections.body: Brother Anton sends you to Southshore, a town in the Eastern Kingdoms, to find Raleigh the Devout, a crusader. Anton seals a letter with his mark. He says Raleigh will give you an escort to a place of honor within the Scarlet Monastery.

sections.title: Raleigh's Reaction
sections.body: Raleigh breaks the seal and reads Brother Anton's letter. The news that Anton still spreads word of the Scarlet Crusade troubles Raleigh. He tells you that something here is beyond your understanding.

faq.q: Who sends you on this journey?
aliases: who gives down the scarlet path
quest giver down the scarlet path
faq.answer: Brother Anton gives you a sealed letter of commendation for Raleigh the Devout.
Brother Anton sends you to Southshore, in the Eastern Kingdoms, to find Raleigh the Devout, a crusader.

faq.q: What does Brother Anton say the letter will do?
faq.answer: Anton says Raleigh will escort you to a place of honor within the Scarlet Monastery after reading his sealed letter.

faq.q: What territory does the Scarlet Crusade claim in Lordaeron?
faq.answer: Brother Anton says the Scarlet Crusade claims strongholds from Hearthglen to Tirisfal Glades, cleansing bastions he takes pride in.
